sentences.text:
This first application has been filed by the applicant under Section 439 o f the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.89/2023, dated 12.03.2023, registered at Police Station Junnardeo,
District Chhindwara (M.P.) for commission of offence under Sections 406, 420, 422, 120-B of IPC.

Applicant is in detention since 26.05.2023.
2.

As per the prosecution story, on 12.03.2023, eleven complainants moved an application in writing before police alleging that applicant along with his nephew Kadir Siddiqui collected an amount of more than Rs.3 crores from them and others and issued cheques of the bank assuring that whenever they will present cheque in the bank same will be encashed.
As such, they cheated 80-90 persons.
But when cheques were presented in the bank, all cheques same stood dishonoured.
FIR was registered.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.
Applicant had issued cheques along with his nephew for returning money but cheques stood dishonoured.
Cases under Section 138 of Negotiable Instruments Act have been filed by the complainants and he is facing trial.
Applicant is in jail for a period of almost seven months.
Offences are triable by Judicial Magistrate First Class.
Therefore, it is prayed that applicant may be released on bail pending the trial.
4 . On the other hand, learned Panel Lawyer for the State has opposed grant of bail and has submitted that applicant has cheated more than Rs.3 crores from innocent investors.
Therefore, he be not released on bail.
5 . In this case, applicant is in jail almost for a period of seven months.
Offence is triable by Judicial Magistrate First Class.

Therefore, having taken into consideration the submissions put-forth by learned counsel for the applicant and other facts and circumstances of the case but without expressing any opinion on the merit of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which applicant may be released on bail.
Consequently, this bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6 . It is directed that applicant - Asif Siddiqui be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.2,00,000/- (Rupees two lakhs only) with two solvent sureties in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees one lakh only) each to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7 .
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case o f bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
